# `csharp_place_method_attribute_on_same_line`

Where a method's attribute section goes. if_owner_is_single_line joins it when the method fits on one line. Deterministic mode only.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `own_line` |  |
| `if_owner_is_single_line` |  |

**Default:** `own_line`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    [Obsolete]
    public void OldWay() { }

    [Obsolete("use NewWay")]
    public string OldName { get; set; } = "";
}
```

### `csharp_place_method_attribute_on_same_line = own_line`

```ini
csharp_place_method_attribute_on_same_line = own_line
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_place_method_attribute_on_same_line = if_owner_is_single_line`

```ini
csharp_place_method_attribute_on_same_line = if_owner_is_single_line
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    [Obsolete] public void OldWay() { }

    [Obsolete("use NewWay")]
    public string OldName { get; set; } = "";
}
```
